stemMarkdown: In what ratio must a solution containing 26% acid be mixed with a solution containing 60% acid to obtain a mixture that is 34% acid? Give the ratio (cheaper : dearer) in simplest form, e.g. '3:2'.
solutionMarkdown: By alligation: $\dfrac{\text{cheaper}}{\text{dearer}} = \dfrac{y - z}{z - x} = \dfrac{60 - 34}{34 - 26} = \dfrac{26}{8} = 13:4$ (after simplifying by dividing both terms by 2).
